손가락.x: I cut my finger on a knife.
손가락.t: Pronounced [손까락]. Toes are 발가락 — literally 'foot fingers'.

정말.forms: 정말 + adjective/verb: 정말 좋아요; as a question: 정말요?
정말.e: 정 right + native 말 (words) — literally 'right words'.
정말.t: 정말요? means 'Really?' — a handy reaction in conversation.

집안일.x: On weekends, I do the housework together with my husband.
집안일.t: Pronounced [지반닐] — an extra ㄴ sound is inserted before 일.

정원.ex: 우리 집 정원에 장미꽃이 많이 피었어요.
정원.x: Lots of roses have bloomed in our garden.
정원.e: Literally 'courtyard garden'. Homonym: another 정원 means 'seating capacity'.

복사하다.m: to copy, to photocopy; to copy (on a computer)
복사하다.ex: 이 서류를 다섯 장 복사해 주세요.
복사하다.x: Please make five copies of this document.
복사하다.t: On a computer, copy and paste is 복사하고 붙여넣다, often just 복붙 in slang.

이렇게.forms: 이렇게 + verb/adjective: 이렇게 해 보세요 · 이렇게 많아요?
이렇게.m: like this, this way; so, this much
이렇게.ex: 이 버튼을 이렇게 누르면 문이 열려요.
이렇게.x: If you press this button like this, the door opens.
이렇게.e: From 이렇다 (to be like this) + -게 (adverb ending).

공기.x: Now that we're in the mountains, the air is really clean.
공기.e: Literally 'empty air' — the air filling space.

당하다.m: to suffer, undergo (something bad), be subjected to
당하다.x: My friend was in a car accident and was hospitalized.
당하다.e: From a syllable meaning 'to face, meet head-on' — facing something unwelcome.
당하다.t: Attaches to nouns to make 'be done to': 무시당하다 'be ignored', 거절당하다 'be rejected'.

속이다.m: to deceive, trick, cheat; to lie about
속이다.ex: 그 사람은 나이를 속이고 회사에 들어갔어요.
속이다.x: That person lied about their age to get into the company.

녹화.x: That show isn't live; it's prerecorded.
녹화.e: Literally 'recording pictures'; audio recording is 녹음.
녹화.t: Pronounced [노콰]: ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

사교육.ex: 많은 학생들이 방과 후에 학원에서 사교육을 받아요.
사교육.x: Many students get private tutoring at cram schools after school.
사교육.t: It means tutoring and cram schools outside regular school, not attending a private school.

진취적.ex: 우리 회사는 진취적인 인재를 찾고 있어요.
진취적.x: Our company is looking for enterprising people.
진취적.e: Literally 'advancing and taking' — going after new opportunities.

훑어보다.x: I quickly skimmed the materials before the meeting.
훑어보다.e: 훑다 'to strip, run along' + 보다 'to look'.

그림의 떡.m: pie in the sky; something you want but can't have
그림의 떡.ex: 그 비싼 차는 저한테 그림의 떡이에요.
그림의 떡.x: That expensive car is just a dream for me.
그림의 떡.e: Literally 'a rice cake in a picture'—you can see it but can't eat it.
그림의 떡.t: 의 here is usually pronounced [에]: [그리메 떡].
nb: 발 없는 말이 천 리 간다

석가탄신일.x: On Buddha's Birthday, I went to a temple with my family.
석가탄신일.t: Pronounced [석까탄시닐]: ㄱ after ㄱ becomes tense. A public holiday on the 8th day of the 4th lunar month; since 2017 its official name is 부처님 오신 날.

밝혀내다.m: to find out, to uncover, to reveal
밝혀내다.x: Scientists uncovered the cause of the disease.
밝혀내다.e: 밝히다 'to make bright, reveal' + 내다 'to bring out, achieve' — bringing the truth into the light.
밝혀내다.t: Pronounced [발켜내다]: ㄺ + ㅎ gives ㄹ + ㅋ.

유전적.ex: 이 병은 유전적 요인이 크다고 알려져 있습니다.
유전적.x: This disease is known to have a strong genetic factor.
유전적.t: Don't confuse with 유전 'oil field', a homonym; 유전자 'gene' is the related everyday word.

교과목.x: My favorite school subject is history.

색채.ex: 이 화가는 밝고 화려한 색채를 많이 사용해요.
색채.x: This painter uses a lot of bright, vivid colors.

비롯되다.m: to originate, to stem from, to begin with
비롯되다.x: This problem stemmed from a small misunderstanding.
비롯되다.e: Built on native 비롯 'beginning'; compare 비롯하다 'to start with, to include.'
비롯되다.t: N을 비롯한 means 'including N': 서울을 비롯한 대도시들.

낫 놓고 기역 자도 모른다.forms: 낫 놓고 기역 자도 몰라요 · 낫 놓고 기역 자도 모르다니
낫 놓고 기역 자도 모른다.m: to be completely illiterate or ignorant; not to know the first thing
낫 놓고 기역 자도 모른다.ex: 저는 컴퓨터에 대해서는 낫 놓고 기역 자도 몰라요.
낫 놓고 기역 자도 모른다.x: When it comes to computers, I don't know the first thing.
낫 놓고 기역 자도 모른다.e: A sickle is shaped like ㄱ (기역); not seeing that means knowing nothing at all.

밑거름.m: base fertilizer; foundation, groundwork (for later success)
밑거름.ex: 어릴 때의 독서가 그의 성공에 밑거름이 되었어요.
밑거름.x: Reading as a child laid the groundwork for his success.
밑거름.e: 밑 'bottom' + 거름 'fertilizer': fertilizer put in the soil before planting.

행간.m: between the lines; space between lines
행간.ex: 그의 글은 행간을 잘 읽어야 진짜 의미를 알 수 있어요.
행간.x: With his writing, you have to read between the lines to get the real meaning.
행간.t: The set phrase 행간을 읽다 matches English 'read between the lines.'

외환보유액.x: Korea's foreign exchange reserves exceed 400 billion dollars.
외환보유액.t: Koreans call the 1997 crisis 외환위기 or simply IMF, as in IMF 때 'during the IMF crisis'.

국무회의.x: The president presided over a Cabinet meeting this morning.

수도승.ex: 수도승들은 새벽마다 함께 모여 기도를 드려요.
수도승.x: The monks gather together every dawn to pray.
수도승.e: Literally 'Way-cultivating monk'; used for monks of any religion.
수도승.t: For Korean Buddhist monks, people normally say 스님 rather than 수도승.

역사시대.m: the historical period (era with written records)
역사시대.x: The historical period began when written records appeared.
역사시대.e: The era of written history, as opposed to 선사시대 (prehistory).

흥진비래.m: joy ends and sorrow follows; life's ups and downs
흥진비래.ex: 흥진비래라더니 좋은 일 뒤에 힘든 일이 생겼어요.
흥진비래.x: Just as they say, after joy comes sorrow — hard times followed the good ones.
흥진비래.e: Literally 'when joy is used up, sorrow comes'.
흥진비래.t: Its opposite pair is 고진감래 'after bitterness comes sweetness'.

용의주도하다.x: He meticulously prepared for every situation.
용의주도하다.e: Literally 'attention used, reaching all around' — nothing overlooked.
용의주도하다.t: Can sound sinister: 용의주도한 범인 'a meticulous criminal'.

오롯이.ex: 주말에는 오롯이 저만을 위한 시간을 보내요.
오롯이.x: On weekends, I spend time entirely for myself.
오롯이.e: Adverb of 오롯하다 'whole, complete, with nothing missing'.
오롯이.t: Pronounced [오로시]; popular in writing: 오롯이 집중하다 'to focus completely'.

극소화하다.ex: 안전 장비는 사고 피해를 극소화하는 데 도움이 됩니다.
극소화하다.x: Safety gear helps minimize damage from accidents.

올곧다.ex: 우리 선생님은 평생 올곧게 살아오신 분이에요.
올곧다.x: Our teacher is someone who has lived an upright life.
올곧다.e: Contains 곧다 'straight'; 올 probably means 'a strand of thread'.

즉결심판.ex: 그는 길에서 노상방뇨를 하다가 즉결심판에 넘겨졌습니다.
즉결심판.x: He was referred to summary trial for public urination.
즉결심판.e: Literally 'trial decided on the spot' for petty offenses.

적혈구.ex: 적혈구는 폐에서 받은 산소를 온몸에 운반합니다.
적혈구.x: Red blood cells carry oxygen from the lungs throughout the body.
